response.consequence: One permanently failing cancelled reminder can stop all later cancelled reminders from being cancelled at SendGrid. Emails for cancelled or rescheduled bookings can then still be sent to attendees.
response.explanation: In the cron handler, the SendGrid cancel request and the reminder deletes sit in a single try block. The prisma.delete calls are lazy PrismaPromises that only run at `await Promise.all(...)` after the loop. If `client.request` throws for any reminder (for example a 400 for a batch that was already sent or is invalid), the loop exits. The catch only logs, so no deletes run, even for reminders already cancelled at SendGrid. The failing reminder keeps `cancelled: true` and stays in the table. It is retried first on every cron run, and it fails the same way each time. Every cancelled reminder after it is blocked until its scheduledDate passes and the first cleanup step deletes it. Before this change, cancellation failures were isolated per call.
